plan.title: SRC-E2E-027 Asset PR to Auction PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is not blocked.
Give the event the mandatory title needed for publishing and later list lookup.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule described by the case.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B's bids without inventing company names.
Publish the configured auction event.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid of 100.
Verify Vendor A's initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid of 85 using the same vendor identity.
Verify Vendor A's revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Close the auction before inspecting QCS and awarding.
Open the comparison grid used for L1 ranking and award preparation.
Verify the first vendor column, representing Vendor A's bid revision, is ranked L1.
Verify the L1 vendor's displayed amount arithmetic is rate multiplied by quantity.
Award all available line items to the lowest bidder, which should be Vendor A at 85.
Confirm that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete the approved award flow and generate the purchase order.
Verify that the generated PO contains the single PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the post-PO lifecycle state.
Open the History tab where the completed event should appear.
Verify that this plan's auction event moved into History.
